title: Show the judged-basis-unavailable reason in terse sealed-source output, and render judged-source and evaluation-detail lines in the observation window's text form
outcome: Show the judged-basis-unavailable reason in terse sealed-source output, and render judged-source and evaluation-detail lines in the observation window's text form
acceptance: When an evaluation is bound to a seal but its judged basis is unavailable, terse show and compact next state that fixed reason (no ids) instead of only 'no comparable later closing sighting'; a terse test covers it

The explicit sealed observation window's TEXT output shows the judged workspace and revision, the first differing observation, the latest endpoint and the evaluation-detail command within its byte budget, matching the JSON; a text-output test covers it

completion.summary: Terse sealed-source output now states the unavailable judged-basis reason. Observation-window text shares the JSON diagnostic, renders judged source, historical difference, latest endpoint and evaluation navigation within its byte budget, and reports bounded previews safely.
